gate2_dependency_surface.target_price_note: target_price is absent from accepted allocator paper trades and is not a dependency of this replay-only policy; entry_date and exit prices are validated per window.

gate4.acceptance_rule: after improves aggregate EV and PnL versus accepted allocator envelope v2, no canonical-window EV/PnL regression, target removal count >= 10, after trade count >= 20, survival >= 5%, and any promotion requires a shared helper plus parity.

hypothesis: Accepted allocator selected trades where the last 5 trading days already consume most of the 20-day trend are front-loaded extension tails; excluding that fixed bucket should improve allocator EV by avoiding gap-chase decay without changing accepted source ordering.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not sweep ret5, ret20, ret5/ret20, hold length, source rank, daily slots, notional, or envelope thresholds on the frozen windows to rescue this bucket.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Use genuinely new tail-state features such as breadth support, same-day displacement type, or forward rows; otherwise stop near allocator tail-threshold tuning.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The front-loaded extension bucket is not a clean decay state for the accepted allocator envelope. Failure reasons: window_ev_regression:late_strong, window_pnl_regression:late_strong, window_ev_regression:mid_weak, window_pnl_regression:mid_weak, aggregate_ev_not_improved, aggregate_pnl_not_improved. The accepted source-priority allocator already selects several momentum/relief mechanisms where recent strength can be the edge rather than a chase signal.

Form4 variants too concentrated/thin: exp-20260530-011, exp-20260609-025
13F latest ingestion is measurement repair only and not PIT for canonical windows: exp-20260613-007
allocator source-score/microstructure retunes saturated or rejected: exp-20260613-006, exp-20260613-009
accepted allocator execution envelope baseline: exp-20260612-024
pre_run_history_check.why_this_is_not_a_repeat: This run tests a fixed tail-state classifier on the accepted envelope-constrained trade stream, not source priority, source score, daily slots, notional, hold length, or calendar timing.

prediction.confidence_reason: Playbook calls for tail-state classifier work, but nearby allocator and microstructure retunes mostly failed and the accepted envelope already arbitrates source quality. This is a fixed diagnostic bucket, not a sweep.

production_impact.production_consistency_note: No production or shared helper behavior changed. A positive result would remain a private lead until the same classifier is promoted into a shared default-off helper with daily snapshot parity.
